data.long_meaning: Derived from the French name Brice, meaning 'bright' or 'shining'. In ancient Greece, Brice was a variant of the name Briareos, which meant 'man of strength' or 'spearman'. The name Brice carries the meaning “Bright, Spear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Brice usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, spear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
